title: Neither upper confidence bound of the corrected analysis is the one the data support
published: at [-0.325, [[0.200]]] for the indirect effect and [-0.625, [[0.175]]] for the direct effect
corrected: at [-0.325, [[0.175]]] for the indirect effect and [-0.625, [[0.200 or higher]]] for the direct effect
note: The bounds are read off the p-value surface saved in the corrigendum's own archive (doi:10.7910/DVN/H47CC6, fig2.rdata). The function that located them returned the first grid point after each edge of the confidence region, which is the first point inside at the lower edge and the first point outside at the upper edge, so the indirect bound sits one step of 0.025 too high. The direct region runs to 0.2, the top of the grid searched, where the function returns no bound at all: the printed 0.175 has no origin in the code, and the data place the bound no lower than 0.2. Both corrected intervals still include zero, which is the corrigendum's conclusion.
